vision: 3D Third-Person Action RPG inspired by Valheim (Iron Gate Studios) with a Cat Knight protagonist

sprints.title: Valheim Survival Loop: Day/Night Cycle, Food Buffs, Interactive Tree Chopping & Stagger Combat
pillars: Dynamic Day/Night lighting and atmosphere (dawn, day, sunset, cold night)
Valheim-style food system (eat up to 3 foods for max HP and Stamina boosts)
Chopping pine trees for wood resources with shaking and falling physics
Tactical combat with enemy stagger meter and parry vulnerability window

tasks: Implement food consumption logic (keys 1, 2, 3 or E interact) applying duration-based HP/Stamina buffs
Implement tree chopping action when hitting trees with weapon
Integrate Cold debuff (reduced stamina regen at night when away from campfire)
Update player HUD status (Food bar buffs, Cold / Rested icons)
Implement enemy posture / stagger meter (fills when hit or parried; when maxed, enemy is stunned)
Add 2.0x damage vulnerability window during staggered state
Increase enemy aggression and sight range during night time
Add night spawn reinforcements (tougher nocturnal skeletons)
Create Day/Night cycle controller (smooth sun rotation, sky procedural color blending, ambient shift)
Create interactive Tree Entity (durability HP, wobble shake animation, falling log spawn, wood drop)
Add forest floor collectible food items (Red Mushrooms, Forest Berries)
Create campfire Rested buff area detection
Review GDScript syntax, references, and node paths across all touched scenes
Run git stage and commit with conventional semantic commit message
Trigger and monitor GitHub Actions CI (godot-build.yml)
Download, verify (unzip -l), and deploy KittenWarrior-Godot4-Windows-x64.zip
Update web prototype portal at port 8080

sprints.title: Deep Tactical Combat & Weapon Arsenal
pillars: Heavy attack charged swing with high stamina cost and massive stagger
Flint Spear and War Club weapon switching [1, 2, 3]
Damage types: Slashing, Blunt, and Piercing with elemental vulnerabilities (Blunt vs Skeletons, Pierce vs Goblins)
Choppable tree wood damage scaling by weapon type (Slashing axes/swords chop 1.5x, spears pierce poorly 0.4x)

tasks: Add weapon switching enum (Sword & Shield, Spear, Club) with visual mesh toggle and key shortcuts [1, 2, 3]
Implement Heavy Charged Attack when holding Left Mouse Button (0.38s charge, 28 stamina cost, 84-112 damage)
Propagate damage type (slashing, piercing, blunt) to targets with camera shake and visual popup feedback
Implement Skeleton crush vulnerability (+75% damage and instant stagger buildup from blunt war club)
Implement Goblin pierce vulnerability (+60% damage from spear thrusts)
Implement Slime damage reactions (slashing slices easily, blunt knocks back and bounces)
Update ChoppableTree to take weapon damage type into account (Slashing chops wood 1.5x fast)
Update Main scene UI HUD to display currently equipped weapon and active damage type
Update Three.js Web Prototype at port 8080 with 3-weapon switching and heavy charged attack
Audit GDScript syntax and node references across player.gd, skeleton.gd, goblin.gd, slime.gd, and choppable_tree.gd
Commit code changes to git main branch and push to GitHub remote
Monitor GitHub Actions CI pipeline godot-build.yml until clean Windows x64 build
Deploy latest build to KittenWarrior-Godot4-Windows-x64.zip and restart web services

sprints.title: Biome Boss Summoning & The Black Forest Altar
pillars: Ancient altar requiring trophy sacrifices to summon boss
Forest Beast boss with thunder stomp, horn charge, and summon minions
Cinematic boss health bar and triumphant Nordic victory anthem

sprints.title: Shelter Building, Crafting & Workbench Progression
pillars: Building hammer with grid snapping for wood walls, floors, and thatched roofs
Workbench crafting stations with progression tiers (Stone -> Bronze -> Iron)
Smoke accumulation physics requiring chimneys to prevent smoke suffocation
